digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI for main branch
propositions: Cancelled workflow runs on main render as red X's on GitHub despite main being healthy, because concurrency groups with cancel-in-progress:true supersede queued builds.
Push-triggered CI for main must be replaced with schedule-only runs (every 6 hours) to eliminate cancellations by construction rather than attempting to hide them.
The scheduled main-health job must publish the last-known-green SHA and emit a copy-pasteable git bisect run recipe on failure to enable rapid remediation without per-commit attribution.
Pre-merge Verified gating via gerrit-verify.yaml remains unchanged; only post-merge mirror safety-net timing is affected, preserving the existing merge gate.

Six workflows must be evaluated for trigger policy changes: test.yml, optionality.yml, verify-identity.yml, prompt-eval.yml, codeql.yml, and terraform-drift.yml; four untouchable mechanisms (gerrit-verify.yaml, reconcilers, external-integration.yml, reusables) are byte-identical.
On-demand workflow_dispatch must be added to all main-health workflows so operators can request an immediate health check without waiting for the 6-hour tick.
